pages.text: Ariadne's thread led Theseus out of the Labyrinth. Shift + right-click ties its end where you stand; right-click in the same world brings you back to it. Three string, red dye and gold, or the labyrinth.

The Pythia chewed Delphic laurel before she prophesied. Burn a leaf (right-click), and she names the nearest monster you have not beaten yet and shows the way. The priestess sells it, the oracle keeps it.
